label: SMOKE fixture — PolitiFact verdict
summary: PolitiFact rated the claim Mostly True: 'The statement is accurate but needs clarification or additional information.' Federal data show ~3,400 Cubans deported in Trump's first term. Human Rights Watch estimated ~8,500 more in the second term as of Aug. 5, totaling close to 12,000, with possibly more since. DHS did not confirm the second-term figure to PolitiFact.
title: PolitiFact: Cubans deportation claim by Angie Nixon

numerical_discrepancy.note: Claim says 'over 13,000'; best available estimate is close to 12,000 with possibly more since Aug 5. Slight overstatement plus reliance on NGO estimate where DHS did not confirm.
